programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: It's Finals Week, and the mystery boxes contain a golden ticket which will fast track the contestant with the top dish into the semi-final, while the others will have to battle it out in pressure test.

programs.title: 1,000 Ways To Dine
programs.desc: Host Michael Yo goes beneath it all to find five of the most unusual dining adventures below and beyond! Dive down twenty feet under the sea for North Atlantic seafood in Norway.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: You may not know that you've been eating tonkatsu for years. Let Rachael reintroduce you to her version of the dish, also known as fried pork chops, served with an umami-rich sauce.

programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Rachael loves gazpacho, a cold soup made from raw vegetables that is perfect for warm Italian summers. She's holding onto the sunshine with her delicious recipe for green tomato gazpacho.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: In traditional Taiwanese cuisine, pig liver was regarded as a luxurious ingredient used in nutrition-boosting dishes. Legendary Chef A-fa showcases the gastronomic potential of pig liver.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Food carving elevates delicacies to visual delights. From dragon made of carrot, taro and shrimps, to phoenix made of bottarga, Taiwanese Chef Liao Ching-chih morphs ingredients into flavorful spectacles.

programs.title: Jake Makes It Easy
programs.sub_title: Soupless Chicken Soup & Carrot Sweet Potato Cake
programs.desc: This roast chicken and vegetable dish is truly two classics in one: amazing roast chicken with all the flavours of a soul-warming chicken soup, without the soup.

programs.title: Theresa Caputo: Raising Spirits
programs.sub_title: Beyond The Readings: We Get The Belt Now
programs.desc: Beyond just accumulating frequent flier miles, Theresa's journey has been one of personal growth and transformation. She offers viewers a rare glimpse behind-the-scenes from her travels.

programs.title: There's A New Killer In Town
programs.desc: Alice is living a quiet life in a small town when she meets Ronnie. The two become fast friends, but soon Holly, another of Alice's friends, suspects there is more to Ronnie than meets the eye.

programs.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
programs.desc: Ambitious flipper Leka finds a promising zombie house but lacks the funds to make it happen. Expert flipper James Dainard is intrigued yet sceptical due to the house's poor kerb appeal and choppy layout.

programs.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out
programs.desc: Dr. Lyndsey joins Dr. Lee to help David, who is fearful that the lump on his jaw might be cancerous. Carla has a mysterious, large bulge on her thigh that concerns Dr. Lee.

programs.title: Masterchef USA
programs.desc: The remaining chefs are back with their first Mystery Box Challenge, apples! With both sweet and savoury flavours, the chef with immunity is tasked with assigning varieties of dish to each region.
